# 2010 Elections

There was 1 election held in Jersey in 2010.

- **[Senator By-Election](https://flow.je/elections/2010#e13)**

  1 seat · 9 candidates · 26.3% turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

* * *

* * *

## 2010 Senator By-Election

[Stuart Syvret](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/stuart-syvret) lost his seat in the house after being absent from Jersey, resulting in a by-election for Senator (1 seat), 16th June 2010.

**[Francis Le Gresley MBE](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/francis-le-gresley) was elected as Senator**.
